Package org.apache.struts2.ognl

Class SecurityMemberAccessConfig

java.lang.Object
org.apache.struts2.ognl.SecurityMemberAccessConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
Initializable
public class SecurityMemberAccessConfig extends Object implements Initializable
Holds the parsed OGNL security configuration for one container.

SecurityMemberAccess is a Scope.PROTOTYPE bean, constructed once per value stack and again for each OGNL context. Parsing the roughly ninety configuration entries on every one of those was the dominant cost identified by WW-5667. This bean is a Scope.SINGLETON, so the parsing happens once per container and each SecurityMemberAccess merely copies immutable references.

Dev-mode is resolved in init() rather than in a setter, because the container iterates getDeclaredMethods(), whose order the JDK leaves unspecified. If init() never runs, the normal production exclusions stay in force, which fails closed.

Since:
Struts 7.4.0
